about: The gradual of the First Sunday of Advent, Psalm 24:3 and 4 in the Vulgate numbering (Psalm 25 in Hebrew). It sings the two verses the introit has just sung, and reads notas fac mihi where the introit reads demónstra mihi.

s01.translation: O Lord, none who wait for You will be put to shame.

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Laity (1846)
translation_citations.locator: parallel Ordinary and Advent propers, examined edition

alignments.gloss: will not be put to shame

s02.translation: Make Your ways known to me, O Lord, and teach me Your paths.
